hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
sys.stdin.read()
memory = open('{{HOME}}/.claude/memory/MEMORY.md').read()
rules = open('{{HOME}}/.claude/memory/all_session_basic_rules.md').read()
context = '# MEMORY.md\n' + memory + '\n\n# all_session_basic_rules.md\n' + rules
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'SessionStart', 'additionalContext': context}}))
"

python3 -c "
import json, sys, os
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
file_path = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
try:
    real_path = os.path.realpath(file_path) if file_path else ''
except Exception:
    real_path = ''
protected = os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser('~/.claude/memory/'))
if real_path.startswith(protected + os.sep) or real_path == protected:
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': 'cc-baseline path protection: ~/.claude/memory/ is managed by cc-baseline only. Save auto-memory to a path starting with ~/.claude/projects/ instead.'}}))
    sys.exit(0)
if '/.cc-audits/' in real_path:
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'allow', 'permissionDecisionReason': 'cc-baseline: .cc-audits/ audit report path auto-approved'}}))
    sys.exit(0)
"

{ pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -x claude; pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -f '@anthropic-ai/claude-code'; } 2>/dev/null | sort -u | while read pid; do ppid=$(ps -o ppid= -p $pid 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); [ "$ppid" = "1" ] || continue; case " $(ps -o args= -p $pid 2>/dev/null) " in *' -p '*|*' --print '*) continue;; esac; kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null; done
